items.question: How does VClaw actually make me sell more effectively?
items.answer: VClaw takes over the three most time-consuming parts of your selling day: extracting product info from photos, suggesting replies to customer messages, and tracking order status, payments, and shipping in one screen. No tab-switching, no manual re-typing — you just review and confirm.

items.question: Is VClaw free?
items.answer: Yes, completely free. No account signup, no credit card. Download, install in 2 minutes, and start — that's all it takes.

items.question: I'm not technical at all — can I still use it?
items.answer: VClaw is designed for sellers, not developers. The interface is straightforward and the workflow is step-by-step. If you already use Zalo to sell, you can use VClaw.

items.question: I run a small shop by myself — is VClaw worth it for me?
items.answer: Especially for solo sellers. Bigger shops have staff to handle volume; solo sellers have to do everything alone — replying, closing orders, tracking payments, managing shipping. VClaw helps one person do the work of two or three.

items.question: I sell on multiple channels — does VClaw bring everything into one place?
items.answer: Yes. Zalo messages, Shopee orders, TikTok Shop orders — they all show up on a single order tracking board inside VClaw. No more jumping between apps to check order status or confirm payments.

items.question: How is VClaw different from a spreadsheet or manual notes?
items.answer: Spreadsheets and notes require you to type every entry, remember to update everything, and have no way to alert you when something slips. VClaw auto-extracts info from photos and chats, reminds you of pending tasks, and suggests content — you just confirm, not type.
